Maya (eng-platform): FYI I pulled together a sketch for how traces / request IDs should flow into the new dashboard work. Need alignment from runtime + infra on headers and sampling.
Carlos (eng-runtime): Nice. Do you have a proposed header name? We currently accept both `X-Request-Id` and `traceparent` in the runtime but we don't consistently tag spans with route/model info.
Maya (eng-platform): Proposal: canonical header `x-rw-cid` carrying our correlation id. If `traceparent` exists, we map it to a `trace_id` field in the span but still ensure `x-rw-cid` is present for lightweight dashboards.
Priya (eng-infra): Quick note: we prefer reusing `traceparent` (W3C) when present for interop, but adding `x-rw-cid` as an app-level header is fine. Keep it small (<= 64 chars). Also watch for customer-supplied IDs — strip PII in ingress filter.
Carlos (eng-runtime): Agreed on both. Implementation plan in runtime: 1) extract `x-rw-cid` or fallback to `traceparent` 2) if missing, generate RFC4122 v4 3) attach id to root span and as `rw.correlation_id` tag on subsequent spans.
Carlos (eng-runtime): Pseudo-code in our middleware:
```
cid = req.header['x-rw-cid'] || parse_traceparent(req.header['traceparent']) || uuid4()
span.setTag('rw.correlation_id', cid)
if should_sample(cid, req) then tracer.start_sampled_span(...) else tracer.start_span(...)
```
Maya (eng-platform): Sampling policy question: dashboards need enough traces for tail latency and error attribution. Can we deterministic-sample based on hashed cid so sampling is stable across retries and retries don't blow up counts?
Liam (eng-sre): Deterministic sampling is best. Hash(cid) % 10000 < 10 => 0.1% baseline. But override to always sample when: 1) response status >= 500 2) latency > 95th percentile (runtime can mark span after completion) 3) rollout/canary routes flagged.
Jenna (product-analytics): For the rollout UX we need to be able to slice traces by rollout id & model version. Can runtime add span tags: `route`, `model.id`, `model.version`, `deployment.variant`? That way dashboards can aggregate traces for A/B/canary.
Carlos (eng-runtime): Yes — adding those as span tags is cheap. Will add `route`, `model_name`, `model_version`, `quantization`, `batch_size`, `gpu_type` where available. Also emit Prometheus counters with labels for `route` + `sampled` so we know sampled vs total.
Priya (eng-infra): Regarding ingress: we can inject `x-rw-cid` at LB when missing and also propagate `x-rw-tenant` for multi-tenant tagging. For privacy we'll redact long header values and log only hashed form in access logs.
Maya (eng-platform): How do we correlate logs + traces in dashboards? We need the same `rw.correlation_id` in logs emitted by sidecars and by async jobs (e.g., background processors).
Liam (eng-sre): Add cid to request context and persist to job metadata: when enqueueing background work do `job.meta.correlation_id = cid`. Also update log formatter to include `rw_cid=%s`. We'll update the SRE runbook for searching `rw_cid:`.
Carlos (eng-runtime): One more: for sampled=false traces we still want minimal metrics to surface request counts/latency by route. Plan: push aggregate histograms from runtime to Prometheus (not full traces). Sampled traces go to jaeger/tempo for span-level debug.
Jenna (product-analytics): Can we add an indicator to Console rollouts that shows "trace support: on/off" per route and sample rate? That will help product QA.
Maya (eng-platform): Yes, Console can read a new Runtime /metrics endpoint exposing `trace.sample_rate` per route and `last_sampled_ts`. UX request: show when traces were last seen for a rollout.
Carlos (eng-runtime): Implementation tasks for runtime: 1) header extraction + generation 2) deterministic sampler function 3) enrich spans with tags listed above 4) expose per-route sample rate metric 5) always force-sample errors & high-latency. I'll open a PR and link infra/console tickets.
Priya (eng-infra): Infra tasks: ingress inject + redaction, support `x-rw-tenant`, ensure logging pipeline indexes `rw_cid`, update WAF rules to ignore `x-rw-cid`.
Liam (eng-sre): Observability tasks: hook sampled traces into dashboard; create an alert for sample_count drop (indicates sampling bug) and an alert for correlation_id missing rate > 1%.
Maya (eng-platform): I'll create a cross-team ticket with the sketch and assign owners. Also we should add a small smoke test: create a canary route that intentionally returns 503s and confirm traces are produced 100% for it.
deploy-bot: deployed 2 tasks to `eng-runtime` staging at 1758564800 :rocket:
Maya (eng-platform): Thanks all — next sync in #eng-platform planning on Wed. TODOs: @Carlos open PR; @Priya create LB ticket; @Jenna add Console mockups; @Liam add SRE alerts. :thumbsup:
